rule: A question is supported only when every required helper class has evidence in the observation log or the pitch fixture explicitly simulates that helper output.

current_repo_summary.architectural_gap: Existing helpers do not all emit one typed observation contract, and recall is split between sidecar files, ask_home specialists, trace_hub graph, and the newer trace_memory event-log boundary.

questions.user_question: What's left of me?
questions.gap: Frame-region detections exist, but egocentric current-scene relations and durable instance IDs are not first-class.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate spatial_scene_graph observations over live detector/OCR records

questions.user_question: Are there duplicate items here?
questions.gap: World memory and counting specialists exist offline, but duplicate-aware live instance memory does not.
questions.pitch_strategy: inject two co-present mug entities and one repeated sighting to prove non-recounting

questions.user_question: Where did I last put my keys?
questions.gap: Object/location can be stored, but handoff/placement events are not reliable typed facts.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate picked_up and put_down relation observations with timestamps

questions.user_question: Which bag was zipped?
questions.gap: Bag zipper attribute helper exists in a narrow offline form; no general live object-state ledger.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate two bag instances with one closure_state=zipped observation

questions.user_question: Was the laptop cable connected?
questions.gap: Laptop/cable attribute scripts exist, but not as universal live state observations.
questions.pitch_strategy: use typed connected_to observation in fixture

questions.user_question: Who said they would send the notes?
questions.gap: ASR and person memory exist; active speaker/speaker identity binding does not.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate said_by relation between ASR segment and known contact

questions.user_question: What were people talking about near me?
questions.gap: Speech rows can be ingested; robust conversation episodes are not first-class.
questions.pitch_strategy: use transcript segments grouped into one conversation episode

questions.user_question: What was that person's name?
questions.gap: Self/person name extraction exists, but generic person-name binding is incomplete.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate introduced_as relation from transcript to visible person

questions.user_question: Which chat was open?
questions.gap: Screen OCR specialist can answer some hardcoded cases; general UI semantic state is missing.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate UI state observation app=Claude active_thread=...

questions.user_question: Was there text waiting to be sent?
questions.gap: One specialist handles an example; no general active-field model.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate input_field status with placeholder vs draft distinction

questions.user_question: Was that restaurant marked as a favorite?
questions.gap: No restaurant/order UI semantic helper.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate favorite_in_app relation from screen helper

questions.user_question: What is my usual order?
questions.gap: No order history, receipt, delivery app, merchant, or behavior ledger helper.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate five order events plus one favorite UI observation and aggregate

questions.user_question: When did I last buy coffee?
questions.gap: No transaction/purchase channel.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate purchase_event observations

questions.user_question: How much did I spend at that restaurant last month?
questions.gap: No commerce ledger.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate order/payment events and date-range aggregation

questions.user_question: Is this my usual route?
questions.gap: Location hints exist, but route behavior ledger does not.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate commute episodes and compare

questions.user_question: Do I usually arrive here this late?
questions.gap: No behavior ledger over visits.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate place_visit episodes

questions.user_question: Who have I been talking to recently?
questions.gap: WhatsApp/iMessage import exists; behavior abstraction should be formalized.
questions.pitch_strategy: use existing importer-style graph attributes

questions.user_question: What did I promise to do?
questions.gap: Message commitment extraction exists; live speech commitments need same schema.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate commitment observations from messages plus speech

questions.user_question: Where am I?
questions.gap: GPS/place and OCR exist; place resolver should combine them under one evidence contract.
questions.pitch_strategy: use place candidate plus visible sign corroboration

questions.user_question: Where did I last see Alex?
questions.gap: Recent people and places exist, but identity binding across face/name/contact is incomplete.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate encounter episode for known person

questions.user_question: What was the ID on that document?
questions.gap: OCR consensus and structured recall exist; needs general text_surface binding.
questions.pitch_strategy: use typed contains_text observations

questions.user_question: Did the cup move?
questions.gap: No generalized object state/change ledger.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate location_changed relation

questions.user_question: What was that loud noise?
questions.gap: Audio event offline detector exists; live sound event observations need to feed same contract.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate sound_event with nearby scene context

questions.user_question: Why did I go to the pharmacy?
questions.gap: Requires intent inference across messages, place visit, and purchase. No unified episode planner.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate message intent plus pharmacy purchase event

questions.user_question: What changed since I was last here?
questions.gap: Inventory exists offline but not place-indexed current-vs-prior diff.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate place-indexed inventory snapshots

questions.user_question: What was I doing?
questions.gap: Context snapshots/digests exist, but current task episode is not a typed durable concept.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate current_task episode from screen + speech + place

questions.user_question: Who do I need to reply to?
questions.gap: Messages can be imported, but reply-needed state and app notifications are not formalized.
questions.pitch_strategy: simulate notification and unread/reply-needed observations

questions.user_question: Why don't you know?
questions.gap: Refusals exist, but they do not consistently explain which context class was absent.
questions.pitch_strategy: make coverage gate return missing_helper_classes
